limits: Research-only Python process, no Node bridge, app packaging or encrypted journal cost measured; compare quality on the shared fixture, not Python/Node timing as algorithm-only speed.
Frozen pretrained English embeddings, only the existing logistic head algorithm is trained; distillation/fine-tuning are not timed.

Cutoffs were declared before evaluation and are diagnostic, not calibrated for this model. BM25 > 0 is an experimental acceptance rule with incompatible score scale; no production migration is proposed.
Same synthetic 94-case fixture, not a real user dataset or multilingual validation. No model can authorize actions; negation/different-action failures require client intent review.
Embedding/context buffer and file byte counts are exact; they exclude Python runtime, tokenizer, package and bridge memory.
Ten warm blocks per metric; p95 is of block averages, CPU includes harness. Single-thread configuration, no GPU and no multiprocessing.
